scenarios.name: Recovery Drive
scenarios.blurb: Buried in the midfield with a fresh set underneath you. Track position is gone -- go and take it back.

scenarios.name: Safety Car Gamble
scenarios.blurb: The safety car is out and the pit lane just got cheap. Take the free stop, or hold the track position you have.

scenarios.name: Cliff Edge
scenarios.blurb: Second place, under a second off the lead, and the inters are starting to go. Chase the win on what's left, or gamble on a stop you may not get back.

scenarios.name: Rain Call
scenarios.blurb: Still dry, but a damp spell is a couple of laps away and you are on slicks. Box early for inters, or stay out and gamble that the shower is short.

scenarios.name: VSC Gamble
scenarios.blurb: You are P5 in the midfield, on tired inters with no stop made, and a virtual safety car has just made the pit lane cheap. Take the stop now, or stay out and hold your track position.

scenarios.name: Sprint Finish
scenarios.blurb: Six laps of the sprint left and you are P5. The softs in P3 are already past the cliff. Push now and go and get them.

scenarios.name: Red Flag Restart
scenarios.blurb: Red flag from P8, sixteen laps to go, and everyone gets a free tyre change. Pick the right restart tyre and the win is on.
